Provenance of the upstream code this package is derived from. Nothing here is
sourced at runtime; it exists only so the genealogy of the packaged code is
auditable. The refactored, packaged implementations live in the package's R/ (at
the repo root); see the per-file mapping in README.md ("Provenance & genealogy").
vendor/ is .Rbuildignore'd, so none of it is part of the built package.

perou-lab/
    Upstream Perou Lab PAM50 repositories (Joel S. Parker & Charles M. Perou),
    kept as pinned git SUBMODULES (exact, tamper-evident upstream commits) rather
    than copies. See perou-lab/PROVENANCE.txt for the commit pins and the per-file
    mapping. Populate with:
        git submodule update --init vendor/perou-lab/*

Top-level R scripts (author: Alec Lobanov, Perou Lab) — kept as UNMODIFIED copies,
snapshotted from the bcarc_wts modules/PAM50 stage on 2026-10-20. (These are the
lab's own code and have no standalone public upstream repo to submodule, so they
stay vendored as copies.) Do not edit — treat as read-only references.

    PAM50_zhao_normalization.R    Zhao4 ER/HER2 subtype-specific quantile centering
                                  -> packaged as R/zhao.R
    clustering_scripts.R          Cluster 3.0 centroid-linkage replication
    cluster3_replicate.R          (.atr/.gtr/.cdt generation)
    identify_claudin_low.R        claudin-low calling from the cluster tree
                                  -> the three above packaged as R/clustering.R
    intrinsic_clustering.R        driver tying clustering + heatmap together
                                  -> logic folded into R/subtype.R / R/run.R /
                                     R/perou_plots.R

PAM50 assay protocol: Arantxa Fernandez-Martinez (Perou Lab).
